title: Ruby on Rails 8: From Zero to Production
description: A practical, self-paced written course that takes you from an empty folder to a tested, fast and deployed Rails 8 application. You build one real app step by step, using the tools Rails 8 ships with out of the box.
outcomes: Set up a Rails 8 development environment and understand how a Rails app is structured
Model data with Active Record: migrations, validations, associations and queries
Build complete CRUD features with RESTful routes, controllers, views and Hotwire
Add authentication, background jobs and email using the Rails 8 built-in tools
Write automated tests and find and fix common performance problems
Deploy your application to your own server with Kamal 2

lessons.title: Your First Rails App
lessons.description: Install Ruby and Rails, create a new app, explore the project structure and follow a request through the MVC pattern.

lessons.title: Models and Active Record
lessons.description: Create database tables with migrations, add validations and associations, and query your data from the Rails console.

lessons.title: Routes, Controllers and Views
lessons.description: Build full CRUD pages with RESTful routes, controllers, strong parameters, ERB views, layouts, partials and flash messages.

lessons.title: Forms and Hotwire
lessons.description: Master form_with and make your app feel fast and interactive with Turbo Drive, Turbo Frames, Turbo Streams and Stimulus.

lessons.title: Authentication and Authorization
lessons.description: Add sign-in with the Rails 8 authentication generator, work with sessions and the current user, and protect actions.

lessons.title: Background Jobs and Email
lessons.description: Move slow work out of the request with Active Job and Solid Queue, and send email with Action Mailer.

lessons.title: Testing Your Rails App
lessons.description: Write model, controller and system tests with Minitest and fixtures so you can change code with confidence.

lessons.title: Building a JSON API
lessons.description: Expose your data as a versioned JSON API with dedicated controllers, JSON rendering and token authentication basics.

lessons.title: Performance and Caching
lessons.description: Fix N+1 queries, add the right indexes, analyze slow queries and cache expensive work with Solid Cache.

lessons.title: Deploying to Production with Kamal
lessons.description: Prepare your app for production and deploy it to your own server with Kamal 2.
